Hi! Thanks for being here. We've moved most of our videos and resources to our private community. If you'd like to continue learning with us and access exclusive content, you can join the community here: https://rpxbcc2o1kbcztlx2yph.app.clientclub.net/communities/groups/pain-science-collective

At Pain Science Physical Therapy, we view mobility from a whole body perspective and treat our patients with the goal of getting to the root of their pain or movement problems. Our therapists develop individualized treatment plans that fit our patients’ bodies and help them live their best lives.

If you are interested in meeting with a physical therapist for help personalized to your needs, visit our website at https://www.painscienept.com/ or call us at (206) 327-9880.
